title: Restore three independent textkit behaviors
prompt: Please fix three independent regressions in textkit. In words.slugify, separators at either edge should disappear. In config.parse_config, the last occurrence of a duplicate key should supply its value without moving the key or merging case variants. In sequences.chunked, retain a final incomplete chunk, including when the entire input is smaller than the requested size. Preserve each function's remaining documented behavior.
parts: Remove edge separators from slugs in words.py.
Restore last-value precedence and stable key order in config.py.
Retain final partial chunks in sequences.py.
